_comment: Where the supply of each exchange coin is read (coin-supply.js). Only sources that answered with the coin's own chain figure when checked on 2026-10-05; a coin without a verifiable source is left out and shows no market cap. Types: chainz (chainz.cryptoid.info, q=circulating), iquidus (/ext/getmoneysupply of the coin's explorer), blockchair (stats.circulation, in base units), coinexplorer (coinexplorer.net api/v1 circulationSupply, used only while its last block is recent; on 2026-10-05 its VIVO and FIRO explorers were stopped at old blocks), min_height on a source = the explorer is used only from that block on (VIVO: its V2 network starts at block 2,176,696; on 2026-10-05 this explorer was still at 2,176,695, last block 2026-10-03), firo (emission of the official code at the current block, see coin-supply.js), number (an address that answers with the supply as a plain number). Added on 2026-10-08, each checked that day: evm_token (total supply of a token contract on bsc, ethereum or polygon, minus the burn addresses -- a token's market cap is therefore price x everything issued and not burned), waves_asset (quantity of an asset on Waves), xmr_explorer (emission monitor of a Monero-family explorer; decimals from the coin's cryptonote_config.h: MYT has COIN = 10^9), karbo (already_generated_coins of Karbo's official node). Looked at and left out that day: EAC and ENRG (their chainz explorers are gone), NEXO, NFT and BTTC (large treasuries: the contract total is far from what circulates), the mempool-style explorers of AURE, BC3, HRC, MYDOGE and WJK (no supply figure), RICK (its explorer answers supply 0). Added on 2026-10-26 (owner asked for the coins missing from the ranking), each checked that day: JKC and LPEPE (iquidus), NNS (json_field: /api/supply of the official 996-Coin explorer, the sum of every balance on the chain), BLURT and SRY (steem: current_supply from the chain's own RPC node, rpc.blurt.blog and api.serey.io), XMR (xmr_explorer at xmrchain.net, COIN = 10^12 in Monero's cryptonote_config.h), BTG (btc_emission: Bitcoin's emission kept by BTCGPU's GetBlockSubsidy, at the height of the in-sync Blockbook btgexplorer.com). Left out that day: ARB (Arbitrum token, large treasuries), SAT and MEWC (cryptoscope.io answers a Cloudflare challenge), XMG, LC2 (no coin information on Cexius to identify them), and explorers that publish no supply (blocksaurus.com HEMP/ALPHA/NOID/FIRST, the custom explorers of SHIC, TSC, C64, KRX, AMA, BUL, SOLEN, PBC, MWC, ADVC).
notes_comment: Coins looked at and left without a source, with the reason shown next to their explorer link (codes of coin-supply.js status()). 2026-10-08: NEXO, NFT, BTTC -- large treasuries, the contract total is far from what circulates; RICK -- its explorer answers supply 0; EAC, ENRG -- chainz says the blockchain is unknown or its hosting expired.
